description: This file contains a C# class 'SQSStorage' that acts as a wrapper/helper for AWS SQS queue operations, including queue initialization, message sending, receiving, and deletion.

classes.name: SQSStorage
classes.description: Wrapper/Helper class around AWS SQS queue service, providing methods to manage queues and messages.

methods.name: SQSStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SQSStorage with logger, queue name, connection string, and optional service ID.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses the connection string to extract AWS credentials and service endpoint.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates an AmazonSQSClient instance based on the parsed parameters, supporting local, explicit credentials, or IAM role-based access.

methods.name: GetQueueUrl
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the URL for the configured queue.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes the queue by creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: AddMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the SQS queue.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the queue, up to a specified count.

methods.name: DeleteMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specific message from the queue.

methods.name: ReportErrorAndRethrow
methods.description: Logs an error and rethrows it encapsulated in an AggregateException.

methods.name: LogErrorSQSOperation
methods.description: Logs an error related to an SQS operation, likely implemented via source generator or partial method.
